manifest.claim_text: Solvers converge at their advertised order, remain stable, conserve their declared invariants, and are bitwise reproducible for a fixed seed.
manifest.falsified_by: an observed order below the advertised order, non-finite or unbounded state, invariant drift beyond tolerance, or non-determinism at a fixed seed
manifest.consequence_if_failed: The solver may not be used for claim-bearing inference until it converges; results produced with it are withdrawn.
non_goals: These checks establish code correctness only. Numerical correctness is necessary, never sufficient: agreement with recorded signals is stronger, held-out perturbation stronger still (thesis §0.2).

blocking_reasons: solver_convergence: could not run — no solver supplied (agent E dynamics / agent G field solvers)
solver_stability: could not run — no trajectory supplied
conservation: could not run — no trajectory or no invariant function supplied; a module that declares no invariant cannot claim a conservation property
seed_reproducibility: could not run — no stochastic entry point supplied
